Messages.Author: pispas
Messages.Body:
Some questions about how this promo works:

Inceptor
Unique Master

Put this card on a vampire of capacity 1, and put three cards from
your hand, ash heap or library on this card, face up but out of
play.This vampire may play other copies of these cards as if he or she
had the Discipline required (if any) at superior.

Can this vampire play cards using only the inferior level of the cards
on this cards, or he can only use the superior level of them?

Can the vampire with this card use dual discipline cards as if he had
all the disciplines required by the card, at whatever level?

This card allows a vampire to meet the requirement of a discipline,not
other requirements like traits,sect, clan, etc but could he use
anarch's three ways at all levels if he or she is already an anarch?

Messages.Author: jwnew...@bellsouth.net
Messages.Body:
On May 8, 10:55 am, pispas <pis...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Some questions about how this promo works:
>
> Inceptor
> Unique Master
>
> Put this card on a vampire of capacity 1, and put three cards from
> your hand, ash heap or library on this card, face up but out of
> play.This vampire may play other copies of these cards as if he or she
> had the Discipline required (if any) at superior.
>
> Can this vampire play cards using only the inferior level of the cards
> on this cards, or he can only use the superior level of them?

"as if he or she had the Discipline required (if any) at superior."

Vampires with the superior Discipline can play the card at inferior.

> Can the vampire with this card use dual discipline cards as if he had
> all the disciplines required by the card, at whatever  level?

No, per the Ian Forestal/Infernal Familiar precedent. Inceptor will
allow the minion to fake one discipline; if he has the other (at any
level) naturally, he can play the card with one discipline faked and
the other at his natural level.

> This card allows a vampire to meet the requirement of a discipline,not
> other requirements like traits,sect, clan, etc  but could he use
> anarch's three ways at all levels if he or she is already an anarch?

Yes.

-witness1
